items.title: Unlocking UK house-building with AI-accelerated planning
items.summary: UK government partners with Google DeepMind to build a new AI-powered prototype aimed at faster housing decisions.
items.summaryZh: 通过人工智能加速规划解锁英国房屋建设与 Gemini 构建的新英国政府人工智能规划原型旨在将处理房主申请所需的时间减少一半在世界各地，政府正在探索人工智能如何更快地提供更好的公共服务。

items.title: Securing the future of AI agents
items.summary: Securing internal systems with an AI Control Roadmap, combining traditional safeguards and real-time monitoring.
items.summaryZh: 确保人工智能代理的未来。我们如何保护内部系统免受功能日益强大且不完美的人工智能的影响。人工智能代理正在改变我们与技术的关系。

items.title: Frontier post-training recipe review with Finbarr Timbers
items.summary: As I’ve been recapping fundamentals of post-training to wrap up my RLHF / Post-training book I knew I needed to get Finbarr Timbers back on the podcast to talk about the state of play. items.title: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
items.summary: OpenAI introduces Deployment Simulation, a method to predict AI model behavior before deployment using real conversation data to improve safety and evaluation accuracy.
